title: Sheep Counts Quiet Sounds
lesson: Quiet sounds help us fall asleep
summary: Sleepless Little Sheep and friends count quiet garden, hill and night sounds and stars until sleepy.

steps.say: The moon was up. It was time for bed, and Little Sheep was tucked in tight.

steps.text: Baa. I am not sleepy. My eyes will not close.

steps.say: Sheep tried to count to sleep. One, two, three... then Sheep lost count.

steps.text: Baa. I will ask a friend for help.

steps.say: So Sheep tiptoed out of the room, very softly, into the garden.
The garden was quiet and dusky. A soft breeze blew.
Cat padded over on quiet paws. Purr, purr.

steps.text: Meow. Why are you up, Sheep?
Baa. I cannot sleep. Can you help me?
Let us listen for quiet sounds. Quiet sounds make us sleepy.

steps.say: They listened. Swish, swish, went the leaves.

steps.text: That is one quiet sound. Can you count with me?

steps.say: Purr, purr, went Cat. That is two quiet sounds.

steps.text: Baa, baa. That is three! I feel a little slow.

steps.say: But Sheep was still not quite sleepy. Let us find more friends.
The sky turned pink, then purple. The friends walked up the hill.
Duck came, with a slow, sleepy waddle.

steps.text: Quack, quack, softly. What are you two doing?
We are counting quiet sounds to help Sheep sleep.
Duck says quack, but only a quiet quack. Quack.

steps.say: That is four quiet sounds. Quack was loud before, but now it was soft.

steps.text: Loud is the opposite of quiet. Baa. I like quiet.
The opposite of day is night. Look up, friends!

steps.say: The three friends looked up at the sky together. It was almost dark.
Now the night had come. Stars popped out, one by one.

steps.text: Let us count the stars. One, two, three...

steps.say: One, two, three, four, five stars. Twinkle, twinkle, twinkle.

steps.text: Five stars. Count them again, softly. One, two, three.

steps.say: Sheep's eyes got heavy. Cat and Duck whispered, shhh, shhh.
Owl came flying. Whoo, whoo, very softly.

steps.text: Whoo, whoo. Night is for sleeping. Go home, little Sheep.
Baa... thank you, friends. Good night.

steps.say: Everyone said good night. Sheep walked home, one slow step at a time.
Back in the bedroom, the moon was bright and the house was still.

steps.text: Baa. Quiet leaves, a soft purr, a soft quack.

steps.say: Sheep climbed into bed and pulled up the blanket.

steps.text: One, two, three, four, five stars. Good night, moon.

steps.say: Sheep's eyes closed, and soon Sheep was fast asleep. Snore, snore.
Sweet dreams, little one. The end!
